transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because something happened at work. I got really worked up during a staff meeting and started acting out a whole fall-prevention drill, moving chairs around and waving my arms. I couldn’t seem to stop, even when people were telling me to sit down.
Has anything like this ever happened to you before, where you felt unable to control your actions or found yourself acting out without meaning to?

Yeah… I mean, the main thing is what happened at that meeting. I got so worked up I started moving chairs around like I was showing a fall-prevention drill, waving my arms and acting it out. People were telling me to sit down, but I just couldn’t stop right then.
Have you ever had experiences where you saw, heard, or believed things that others around you didn’t seem to notice or agree with?

Yeah… sometimes I do hear things. Like if I’m alone in the hallway at work, or at home near the laundry room, I’ll hear my name or hear a resident calling for help, clear as anything. But then when I go check, there’s nobody there.
Have you had experiences like hearing voices or feeling unable to control your actions more often than just this one time at work?

Yeah, it’s happened more than just that meeting. Like I was saying, sometimes when I’m by myself in the hallway at work, or at home near the laundry room, I hear my name or a resident calling for help really clearly. I’ll go check, but there’s nobody there.
Have you ever had beliefs or thoughts that you know are definitely true, but others around you don’t seem to understand or agree with, even when you explain them?

Yeah… I do. Even when I’m calm, I still feel pretty sure my supervisor and a couple people at work are keeping notes on me. Like they’ll make little comments that feel like tests, like they’re trying to prove I’m not safe to be around the seniors. Other people tell me I’m reading into it, but it really feels real to me.
Have these beliefs about your supervisor and others keeping notes on you lasted for a long time, or do they come and go?

They’ve been going on a while… I’d say about nine months now. It’s not every second of the day, but the thoughts about people watching me or keeping notes, and hearing calls that aren’t there, they keep coming back.

Has there ever been a time when you felt like your thoughts were really disorganized, like you couldn’t put your ideas together properly, or when you had trouble speaking clearly because your thoughts were so jumbled?

I don’t know… not really like I couldn’t talk or make sense. I get stressed and my mind can feel busy sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed my thoughts being so jumbled that I couldn’t put words together.
Have you noticed any problems with your work performance or relationships with others because of these experiences?

Yeah, it has. I got put on leave from the senior center, so that’s been a big problem. At home, my wife’s had to remind me about chores and appointments more than she used to, because I’m not keeping up like I normally would.

And I’ve kind of pulled back from people at church too. I just don’t feel as comfortable being around everybody. I’m worried about whether I can safely go back to doing caregiving work.
Have you had these experiences — like hearing voices, feeling watched, or having these thoughts — every day or on and off for the past 6 months or more?
Yeah… it’s been on and off, but for more than six months. The suspicious thoughts and hearing calls that aren’t really there have been happening for about nine months now.
Have you noticed a big drop in how well you’re able to work or handle your usual responsibilities because of these experiences?

Yeah, there has been a pretty big drop. I was put on leave from the senior center, and at home my wife has to remind me about chores and appointments because I’m not keeping up like I used to.

I’ve also pulled back from people at church, and I’m worried about whether I can safely go back to caregiving work.

Have you had any periods where you experienced these thoughts or experiences — like hearing voices or feeling like people are watching you — every day or almost every day for at least a month at a time?

Yeah… there have been stretches like that. The suspicious thoughts and the calls I hear that aren’t really there have been going on for about nine months now, and during parts of that it felt like it was happening pretty much every day.
Can you tell me if there was a time when the thoughts about people watching you or the voices you heard lasted without a break for at least a whole month?

Yeah… I think so. There was a stretch where the suspicious thoughts and those calls I was hearing that weren’t really there just kept happening. It’s been going on about nine months overall, and at times it felt like there wasn’t really a break from it for at least a month.
